commands.name: library.list
commands.description: List the works in the nBooks library with work id, title, authors and formats, sorted by title, paged.

query.description: Optional filter on title or author

commands.name: library.search
commands.description: Search the passages of every indexed book by keyword, plus meaning when the on-device encoder is loaded. Returns passage hits with work id, passage id, location and a short excerpt.

query.description: Words or a question to search for

commands.name: passage.get
commands.description: Return the text of one passage, with neighbouring passages if asked, bounded in length, plus the citation fields: title, authors, chapter or page.

workId.description: Work id from library.list or library.search

context.description: Passages to add on each side; default 0

commands.name: reader.open
commands.description: Open one passage in the nBooks reader and bring nBooks to the front, so the person can read it in place.

workId.description: Work id from library.list or library.search

commands.name: annotation.list
commands.description: List the highlights, notes and bookmarks the person made in one work, or in every work, with the quoted text and location.
